question: Does terminal-target-local eligibility trace lambda improve standard-Chess W-L over fixed TDLeaf lambda=.95 at equal paid training nodes?

candidate.per_residual_rule: For residual delta_t with next observed target q[t+1], use eligibility sum_j lambda_t^(t-j)*gradient_j; lambda_t=1 only if q[t+1].pv_terminal is true, else .95.
candidate.unknown: Censor final residual; never impute draw or win/loss.

conditions.baseline: Reuse frozen task2568 TD(lambda=.95) endpoints at 1M nodes and matching initial vectors; count their historical paid cost.
conditions.search: D2 plain with task2568 query and history semantics
conditions.evaluation: Initial, frozen baseline-TD endpoint, and candidate endpoint for each seed; 64 matched fresh-root slots per endpoint/seed (768 slots total), balanced roles against the same uniform foe.
conditions.training_root_policy: Use task2568's registered Chess training family semantics with new nonoverlapping candidate families; audit exact root overlap before evaluation.
conditions.evaluation_root_policy: Generate and freeze fresh roots before candidate fitness; mechanically exclude every root in all TRAIN records.

adopt_for_generic_transfer_only_if: At least 128 terminal-target residuals are observed in each of the existing baseline and candidate training conditions.
Finite paired W-L lower bound is >0 for candidate endpoint minus ordinary TD endpoint.
Finite paired W-L lower bound is >0 for candidate endpoint minus its initial weights.
decision_rule.otherwise: Retain all results; do not migrate this update to Generic and do not tune on these evaluation roots.
decision_rule.unknown_and_missing: Keep UNKNOWN in [-1,1] paired bounds; report missing slots and frozen-cap partials without extending caps.

cost.estimate_basis: DEV_AUX97 1M-node Chess endpoints and NEXT_STUDY_20261019_97 832-slot cost estimate.
cost.threshold: If expected duration reaches 120 minutes, obtain Dot necessity assessment before launch; do not split to evade.

scope: Engineering validation of a prospective search-target update on a finite Chess panel; not full TreeStrap reproduction, population strength claim, or Generic result.
